visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, bangs, and a beige sweater sits in a brightly lit room with a beige sofa and wall-mounted cat furniture. She enthusiastically presents a large purple rectangular box decorated with Chiikawa characters in traditional Chinese clothing. White and yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the box, showcasing detailed character art and text. The woman's hands hold the box securely, rotating it to show the back which illustrates eight different miniature food sets. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant colors of the packaging. (3) The woman opens the main box, revealing eight smaller purple boxes packed inside. She uses her hands to pull out an individual small box and then proceeds to unbox a plastic bag containing tiny components. Tiny objects like a bear-shaped bun and a clear cup are shown in extreme close-up against a wooden surface. (4) A rapid sequence of shots shows the woman assembling the miniatures. Each set consists of tiny plates, food items like curry or cake, and small paper mats. Her fingers carefully manipulate the tiny pieces, emphasizing their scale and detail. The background remains the neutral indoor room or the wooden tabletop. (5) The final phase shows all eight sets fully assembled and arranged together. The woman looks directly at the camera with an expressive, squinting smile and gestures towards the miniatures. Large, bold captions like '必收' (Must buy) appear on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bouncy, high-tempo pop BGM with a synthesized melody. The atmosphere is bubbly and bright. (2) A sharp 'crinkle' and 'tear' sound of plastic film being removed marks a transition. The speaker's pitch rises as she expresses excitement, her voice clear and enunciated with no background noise. (3) A loud 'thud' as the box is placed on a table, followed by a 'click' sound as the cardboard lid is opened. The BGM maintains its steady, playful beat in the background. (4) A series of 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects occur rhythmically with each new miniature revealed. Each SFX is sharp and clean, indicating post-production enhancement. (5) The sound of paper rustling is heard as she handles the paper inserts. Her voice becomes softer and more intimate as she describes the small details, like ice cubes in a cup. (6) A final high-arousal exclamation '必收!' is followed by a slight swell in the BGM volume before a quick fade-out.
